fields.statement: At aa5d5f235, go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestDocsExampleWorkflows passes: it globs docs/examples/workflows/*.toml (go, ruby, javascript, python; fails if fewer than 4) and runs rhiza workflow check on each, requiring exit 0 and 'is valid'. A scratch build's rhiza workflow check on each of the four files prints 'is valid', exit 0; mutated copies (a RHIZA_ env name, a dangling on.pass) fail with exit 1, so the check is real. docs/custom-workflows.md gains a 'Cleanup and environment' section explaining [[cleanup]] (runs once at run end in the run worktree, failure never changes the result) and [env] ({run_tmp}, RHIZA_* refused), and links the four examples, each with build, test, [env] and [[cleanup]].
